item.description:
New • A reminder before a weekly limit resets with much of it unused. Turn on Weekly limit left unused in Settings, and Actvt tells you once, a day before the reset, when half or more of the week is still left. You can change both numbers
Improved • Every session shows its real message count. A long session used to show only what fit in its first part, so one with thousands of messages could read 200 • When one model's long-prompt price changes, Actvt re-reads only the sessions that used that model, not every session. The first launch of this update re-reads them once • Plan limits are fetched once at launch, not two or three times
Fixed • An update waiting to install no longer tries to while the welcome screen or another sheet is open. That attempt used to fail, the update then waited for the next launch, and quitting Actvt relaunched it hidden • Remote Sessions no longer shows a loop that runs in a sandbox as ended while it's working or asleep. Hosts get this with actvt-cli 0.12.0

New • What your agents spend on your other machines now counts. Claude Code sessions on a Remote Sessions host go into the Overview's totals and history like the ones on this Mac, and a new card splits spend by machine. A session that's on both is counted once • Hosts need actvt-cli 0.11.0 for this, and the Overview names any machine that's still on an older one
Improved • Long transcripts read several times faster, here and on your Remote Sessions hosts, so a long remote session opens sooner • Codex sessions on GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are priced from the first launch

New • The limits card remembers how each week ended. Under the live bar you'll see last week's share and what that week's work cost on this Mac, and agents can read past weeks over MCP
Fixed • Codex sessions that the Codex app compressed after about a week are back, with their transcripts, search and privacy checks • Claude Code sessions show the title Claude Code gave them again, not their first prompt • Loops no longer read as working while they sit idle at their prompt, or as asleep while they run a shell command • Machines under Remote Sessions get the title and loop fixes with actvt-cli 0.10.3, and Settings offers the update
